title: Ramsey Approach to Vector Fields
content: Ramsey approach to the vectors fields is introduced. Set of vectors defined on R^3, taken as the generators of the bi-colored complete graph, is introduced. Vectors are considered as the vertices of the graph. Following coloring procedure is suggested: vertices numbered i and j are linked with the red edge if their scalar product is non-negative; and they are linked with the green edge if their scalar product is negative. This procedure gives rise to the complete, bi-color graph. Graph generated by six vectors inevitably contains the monochromatic triangle: the Ramsey number Ring-like systems of generating vectors are addressed. Applications of the graphs emerging from the vector fields are discussed. The logics of relations between the vectors is changed for 1D systems of vectors.
